description: 黃大目沙茶豆干 sacha-sauce dried tofu (Taiwan) — traditional Chinese, deeply nested parentheses (sacha sauce contains 11 sub-ingredients), a separate 食品添加物 additives section, and SIX major allergens. The highest-stakes cross-language case in the set.
notes: Label's own allergen declaration 過敏原資訊 confirms: 大豆(soy)、魚類(fish)、甲殼類(crustaceans/shellfish)、麩質的穀類(gluten grains → wheat via 小麥麩皮 wheat bran)、堅果類(tree nuts → 椰子粉 coconut)、芝麻(sesame). Shellfish comes from 蝦 (shrimp) inside the sacha sauce; fish from 魚 and 柴魚粉 (bonito).
